blocks.text: Disaster recovery ensures business continuity when Zscaler service is impacted globally. Disaster recovery is ideal for organizations that depend on the Zscaler cloud to remain operational during disastrous events by providing users with continued access to critical applications.

blocks.heading: Disaster Recovery in the ZSDK Admin Portal

blocks.text: In the ZSDK Admin Portal, you can enable disaster recovery on the following:
When all have been enabled and deployed (i.e., App Connectors, Private Service Edges), you can configure the disaster recovery settings.
On the Disaster Recovery page (Configuring & Control > Administration Control > Disaster Recovery), you can go to the following:

blocks.item: View which defined application segments have disaster recovery enabled.
You can edit an application segment by selecting it.
View which App Connector groups have disaster recovery enabled and their associated App Connectors.
You can edit an App Connector by selecting it.
Disaster Recovery Private Service Edge Groups
View which Private Service Edge groups have disaster recovery enabled and their associated Private Service Edges.
You can edit a Private Service Edge by selecting it.
